body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 82428410ca486598446fe9ff21dfd2c4f7ca3926 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @vilts - a tidy, well-scoped change.

**What looks good**
- `GenError::At` displays exactly like `Invalid`, so no sentence, log or golden changes; a non-finite spot is dropped, never drawn (pinned by `a_non_finite_spot_is_dropped_never_shown`).
- Nothing is generated or cached on a refusal, so a refused op still cannot post.
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests in the diff; no dependency, `build.rs`, `.github` or script changes; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.
- The mark/link is view state (no command needed), and `refusal_focus()` retires the mark on the next command, undo/redo, other op or draft edit.
- Decision record present (`docs/decisions/261-refused-location.md`), body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #261`, conventional commit subject, layering ui -> app -> motion respected.

**Local results (PR trial-merged with current main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-motion lib | 163 passed |
| motion `face_holes`, `ruling` | 7 and 10 passed |
| camcraft-app lib | 103 passed |
| app `refusal_location` | 3 passed |
| camcraft-ui lib (from crates/ui) | 423 passed, 5 ignored |
| clippy motion/app/ui, `-D warnings` (lib, bins, tests of motion+ui, refusal_location) | clean |

**Not caused by this PR:** a full `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` on the merged tree fails on current main itself:
```
error[E0063]: missing field `hand` in initializer of `OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83:18
```
The PR does not touch that file or `OpParams::Threading`; two independently merged main changes disagree. The maintainer may want a one-line fix on main (`hand: ...` in that test).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `gen_error.rs` has no explicit one-line "specced from" provenance (the module doc explains purpose only); worth adding if the maintainer wants the strict form.
- `state.rs` (4060 lines), `interact.rs` and `app/operation/generate.rs` were already far over ~400 lines; this PR grows them slightly.
- The op-page link click was not exercised in a live window (as the PR states); I did not launch the GUI either.
- Whether #261 closes is left to the maintainer (`Refs`).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
